evals.name: Dynamic XML Sitemap Stream in server.ts & Edge Caching
evals.prompt: Implement an edge request handler in src/server.ts intercepting /sitemap.xml to stream raw XML with edge Cache-Control headers before delegating to AngularAppEngine.
evals.expected_output: Creates a request handler returning a raw Response with application/xml; charset=UTF-8 and Cache-Control headers for /sitemap.xml, passing other requests to AngularAppEngine.
assertions: Intercepts /sitemap.xml in server request handler returning a native Response
Applies edge cache headers Cache-Control with public max-age
Delegates general application requests to AngularAppEngine

evals.name: Platform Guarding & Node Native API Isolation in Edge SSR
evals.prompt: Build an SSR-safe SEO service and component using isPlatformBrowser to guard window/document access and eliminating Node.js native module dependencies.
evals.expected_output: Implements SeoService with PLATFORM_ID injection and isPlatformBrowser checks for canonical URL resolution, strictly avoiding Node.js native modules like fs and path.
assertions: Injects PLATFORM_ID and uses isPlatformBrowser to guard browser DOM access
Avoids importing forbidden Node native modules (fs, path, crypto, child_process)
Strips query parameters from canonical URL in setCanonicalUrl
Enforces strict TypeScript typing with zero explicit any annotations

evals.name: Cloudflare Pages _routes.json Bypass & SSR Legal Policy Compliance
evals.prompt: Configure Cloudflare Pages edge route bypass manifest (_routes.json), AdSense ads.txt authorization, and standalone SSR-safe legal policy pages.
evals.expected_output: Provides public/_routes.json excluding static assets and sitemaps from Worker execution, public/ads.txt, and standalone PrivacyPolicyComponent and TermsOfServiceComponent with keyword-rich titles.
assertions: Deploys public/ads.txt declaring authorized publisher status
Scaffolds standalone PrivacyPolicyComponent disclosing GA4 and AdSense DART cookies
Registers keyword-rich route titles for legal policy endpoints
